component.name: Cell
component.script: sub init() m.label = m.top.findNode("label") m.bg = m.top.findNode("bg") end sub sub contentChanged() m.label.text = m.top.itemContent.title m.bg.width = m.top.width m.bg.height = m.top.height print "cell "; m.top.index; " "; m.top.width; "x"; m.top.height; " "; m.top.itemContent.title end sub sub focused() if m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 then m.bg.color = "0x22C55EFF" else m.bg.color = "0x334155FF" end if end sub
